a: Multi-stage builds keep final images small by copying only artifacts.
Volumes persist data beyond container lifetime.
Bridge networks connect containers on the same host.
ENTRYPOINT sets the main executable; CMD provides default args.
HEALTHCHECK tells orchestrators if the container is healthy.
depends_on controls start order, not full readiness.
Tags like :1.2.3 or :latest label image versions.
Registries store and distribute container images.
docker system prune frees unused images, containers, and networks.
